action_effects_by_state.definition: within each metric-estimable content-by-family cell, mean at ratio 1.05 minus mean at ratio 0.65; cells equally weighted; campaign, content, and family strata remain dependent

analysis_recovery_note: The frozen V11D summarizer failed on an undefined metric while averaging complete-by-hold-count cells. This report preserves the frozen endpoints and thresholds, reports unestimable metric cells explicitly, and applies the 13-cell minimum to estimable primary PSNR interactions. No values are imputed.
analysis_unit: crossed content capture group by measured network family; repetitions and trace windows remain nested
limits: Two independently acquired network campaigns are represented; their four radio/operator families are nested and not four independent campaigns.
Trace throughput is replayed as symmetric local queue service rates, not as live public-network transport or packet replay.
Action contrasts are short-term proximal effects conditional on pre-action sender BWE, not closed-loop policy value.
Sampled RGB PSNR and a 150 ms pixel-readback deadline are proxies, not human QoE.
No outcome is pooled with V3-V10, prior archive runs, or synthetic-controller evidence.
primary_endpoint: on-time PSNR 1.05-minus-0.65 action effect at BWE >=500kbps minus the same action effect at BWE <500kbps

primary_replication.reason: four content capture groups and two measurement campaigns support source-stratified directional replication checks, not a population-level confidence claim
primary_replication.rule: positive equal-weight crossed mean; positive means in both acquisition campaigns; positive interactions for at least three of four content capture groups and at least three of four measured network families. Report each source stratum; do not use the 16 crossed cells, repeated profiles, or four nested families as independent replicates.

turn_v2.failure_class: selected local peer-reflexive classification rejected after TURN-backed ICE connection

turn_v3.failure_class: phase-snapshot guard read an unrecorded remote_candidate_type field after the registered session schedule

turn_v4.failure_class: three sessions missed held-out clock coverage; eight sessions violated V4's registered zero-overflow queue rule

turn_v5.failure_class: two sessions missed held-out coverage at the initial high-phase marker m0002

turn_v6.failure_class: 21 sessions missed final held-out marker m0011 and two also missed m0003

runtime.network_policy: TURN control TCP and relay/queue UDP are loopback-only

source_dependence: Three NordicDat operator/RAN/band strata share the NordicDat drive-test campaign; the Rome LTE family comes from a separate active Speedtest campaign. The four family strata count as only two independent measurement campaigns. Windows and Rome subcampaigns remain nested.

schedule_definition.rates_mbps: selected measured downlink throughput resampled to 1 Hz and replayed as local bottleneck service rates

terminal_queue_cleanup.initiator: final m0012 clock-marker request after frame/action observation cutoff

transport.candidate_gathering_acceptance: Both peers complete gathering with only loopback relay candidates using relayProtocol=tcp and zero candidate errors.
transport.media_acceptance: Each scheduled block has more than ten encoded and decoded frames and finite mean encode time; each clip's SHA-256 is verified before serving.
transport.queue_acceptance: Both directions forward at least 100 packets from matching TURN allocation ports, no unexpected sources or send errors; packet and byte replay exactly matches offer/drop/service/forward ledgers; capacity and conservation checks pass.
transport.selected_pair_acceptance: Both pairs are nominated/succeeded and use TURN relay candidates over loopback with relayProtocol=tcp.
transport.trace_scheduler_acceptance: All 18 scheduled measured-rate ticks appear in order in relay events, match the frozen rates exactly, and fall within 150 ms of their registered one-second offsets.
